examples.description: Compound AIC-8/9 audit against the contemporary-essay baseline

artifacts: JSON envelope with per-detector blocks and joint co-occurrence metrics (stdout or --out)

purpose: Compound AIC-8 + AIC-9 audit. Runs kicker density, image conjunction and prestige metaphor together and reports their joint co-occurrence (paragraphs that close on a kicker and also carry an image conjunction, optionally in a prestige domain), the "performing aesthetic authority" signature that the single detectors cannot see, against register-typical or explicit baselines.
use_when: you want one AIC-8/9 report instead of running the three detectors separately
